# Zistgah / Project ILM

> A federated estate of independently implementable components: knowledge, intelligence, realization and continuity. Every component is sovereign, carries its own contract, and can be used without the rest.

Walked 2026-09-18T16:50:30Z. 85 repositories across zistgah, project-ilm; 25 carry a DOI.

## Read these first

- [Master contract](https://github.com/zistgah/governance/blob/main/CONTRACT.md): the rules every repository inherits.
- [Context](https://github.com/zistgah/governance/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): what the estate is and how the parts relate.
- [Agent instructions](https://zistgah.org/AGENTS.md): what an agent may do here.
- [Machine index](https://zistgah.org/index.json): every repository as JSON.
- [Catalogue](https://zistgah.org/catalog.json): a typed graph of organisations, repositories, published pages and deposited works, with every entry file linked by its raw URL so nothing has to be guessed.
- [Memory reconciliation](https://zistgah.org/memory-reconciliation.json): what an AI assistant believed about this estate, checked against the forge. Read it before trusting any second-hand account of what exists here, including its own.

## How to work here

- Retrieve before you assert. A repository's live state is in the repository.
- Where a value is unknown, write `not established`. Do not estimate.
- A claim needs a measurement in the same change.
- One work package, one pull request, one proof.
- Nothing is pushed or minted except by the author, under a typed gate.
